tasks.subject: Task 1: Decks API search, filter, sort
tasks.description:
**Goal:** GET /api/decks?q=&module_id=&sort= filters by name substring, filters by module, and orders by created_at in either direction, in one macro-checked query.

**Files:**
- Modify: `backend/src/routes/decks.rs`
- Test: `backend/tests/decks.rs`
- Regenerate: `.sqlx/` (root)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] ?q=kine matches case-insensitively; absent or empty q applies no filter
- [ ] q does NOT match against description
- [ ] ?q=100% is treated literally, not as a wildcard
- [ ] ?sort=oldest reverses ?sort=newest; absent sort == newest
- [ ] same-second decks order deterministically via the id tiebreak
- [ ] ?module_id=all equals absent; none and <n> keep Part 1 behaviour
- [ ] ?sort=sideways returns 422 with a sort field error
- [ ] ?module_id=abc returns 422 with a module_id field error
- [ ] all three criteria combine correctly
- [ ] the three existing list queries are replaced by ONE query_as!

**Verify:** `cargo test --test decks` → all pass; `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` → clean

Full steps with code: `docs/mitis/plans/2026-08-26-decks-search-filter-sort.md` → "Task 1: Decks API search, filter, sort"

```json:metadata
{
  "files": [
    "backend/src/routes/decks.rs",
    "backend/tests/decks.rs",
    ".sqlx"
  ],
  "verifyCommand": "cargo test --test decks && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && SQLX_OFFLINE=true cargo build",
  "acceptanceCriteria": [
    "q matches name substring case-insensitively; empty or absent q applies no filter",
    "q does not match description",
    "q treats % and _ literally",
    "sort=oldest reverses sort=newest; absent sort equals newest",
    "same-second decks order deterministically via the id tiebreak",
    "module_id=all equals absent; none and numeric keep Part 1 behaviour",
    "sort=sideways returns 422 with a sort field error",
    "module_id=abc returns 422 with a module_id field error",
    "criteria combine correctly",
    "exactly one query_as! replaces the previous three"
  ],
  "modelTier": "standard"
}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Flat deck list with toolbar and badges
tasks.activeForm: Implementing the decks toolbar and flat list
tasks.description:
**Goal:** /decks renders one flat, searchable, filterable, sortable list of deck cards, each showing its module as a badge.

**Files:**
- Modify: `frontend/src/lib/api.ts`, `frontend/src/pages/DecksPage.tsx`
- Add: `frontend/src/components/ui/badge.tsx` (via the shadcn CLI)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] no module <section> grouping remains — one flat grid of deck cards
- [ ] each card shows a module badge, or a muted "No module" badge when unparented
- [ ] clicking a card's module badge sets the module filter to that module
- [ ] toolbar: search input, module Select, sort Select; stacks vertically below sm:
- [ ] typing is debounced ~250ms — not one request per keystroke
- [ ] a slow earlier response cannot overwrite a newer one (no flicker to stale results)
- [ ] two distinct empty states: "no decks yet" vs "no decks match" with a clear-filters action
- [ ] pnpm exec tsc --noEmit and pnpm build both clean
- [ ] editing/creating a deck still works and the list reflects the change

**Verify:** `cd frontend && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm build`, then a browser pass at http://localhost:5273/decks
